preconditions.description: The graph has n vertices (3 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m edges (0 ≤ m ≤ min(n(n-1)/2, 10^5)), with no loops or parallel edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= int(n) and 1 <= int(b) <= int(n) and int(a) != int(b) for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The input contains no duplicate edges (no parallel edges).

postconditions.description: The output consists of two space-separated integers: t (minimum edges to add) and w (number of ways to add t edges).

postconditions.expression: t == 0 and w == 1 if any(len(connected_component) >= 3 and any(len(path) % 2 == 1 for path in all_simple_paths(connected_component)) for connected_component in connected_components) else t >= 0 and w >= 0
postconditions.description: If the graph already contains an odd-length simple cycle (length > 1), then t = 0 and w = 1. Otherwise, t is the minimum edges to add to form such a cycle, and w is the number of ways to do so.

postconditions.expression: t == 1 and w == number_of_odd_cycle_pairs if t == 1 else True
postconditions.description: If t = 1, w is the number of pairs of vertices (u, v) in different connected components where adding edge (u, v) creates an odd-length cycle.

postconditions.expression: t == 2 and w == number_of_triangles_to_form if t == 2 else True
postconditions.description: If t = 2, w is the number of ways to add two edges to form a triangle (3-cycle) in a connected component of size ≥ 3.

postconditions.expression: t == 3 and w == 1 if n == 3 and m == 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the graph is a single isolated vertex (n=3, m=0), t = 3 and w = 1 (forming a triangle).
